speculative 'has been discussed as potentially useful' wording

pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: AP economy / per capita income
wrong topic: AP welfare schemes (overseas study for BCs)

patterns: Direct single-fact items dominate: first BC Commission chairman (Kalelkar), who set up Mandal (Morarji Desai), year of Mandal report (1980).
Amendment-number questions recur: 77th = 16(4A), 82nd = relaxed marks, 93rd = 15(5)/27% OBC in education, 105th assent 2021, 103rd = 124th Bill.
APPSC uses 'all correct except' statement items on definitions (Backward Classes not defined; Art. 338(10)).
AP tilt: Muslim BC quota (AP first to propose), BC welfare schemes.
App has many current-affairs (Rohith Nathan, Rohini findings, AP local-body GOs) and multi-statement items deeper than the PYQs, which stay single-fact.
